story.title: Why we build
body: NeoByte Technology was founded by engineers who wanted to build real systems, not presentations. From the start, the goal was simple: take on hard problems and ship working software that solves them.

We are rooted in Burkina Faso, with direct exposure to global technology ecosystems — from AI research communities to China's manufacturing and commerce networks. That position shapes what we build: technology adapted to the realities of emerging markets, engineered to international standards.

We develop our own products because building for real users is the best engineering discipline there is. Products like Yawoto and Barkosem came out of problems we saw firsthand — and everything we learn from running them goes back into the systems we build for organizations.

geo.title: Built from Africa. Connected to global technology.
geo.body: Our roots are in Africa; our engineering connects to technology ecosystems around the world. We build locally grounded systems to global standards.

policy.title: Privacy Policy, Terms of Service, and Cookie Policy

introduction.title: 1.1 Introduction
introduction.body: This Privacy Policy describes how Neobyte Technology ("Neobyte," "we," "our," or "us") collects, uses, stores, and protects personal information obtained through our software, digital platforms, websites, and services (collectively, the "Services"). By using our Services, you consent to the practices described in this Privacy Policy.

collection.title: 1.2 Information We Collect
collection.intro: We may collect the following categories of information:
items: Personal Information: Name, email address, phone number, company details, account credentials.
Technical Data: IP address, browser type, device information, operating system, usage logs, and analytics data.
Project and Business Data: Files, documents, system configurations, and information shared for software development or service execution.
Payment Information: Billing details and transaction metadata (processed through secure third-party payment providers).

use.title: 1.3 How We Use Information
use.intro: Neobyte Technology uses collected data for:
items: System optimization, performance analysis, and troubleshooting.
Improving products, features, and user experience.

sharing.title: 1.4 Data Sharing and Disclosure
sharing.body: We do not sell client or user data. We may share information with:
items: Authorized employees and subcontractors bound by confidentiality.
Third-party service providers assisting in hosting, analytics, payments, or infrastructure.

security.title: 1.5 Data Security
security.body: We implement industry-standard security controls including encryption, access management, and secure development practices to protect data integrity and confidentiality.

retention.title: 1.6 Data Retention
retention.body: Data is retained only as long as necessary for operational, legal, or contractual purposes.

rights.title: 1.7 User Rights
rights.intro: Depending on your jurisdiction, you may have the right to:
items: Access, correct, or delete your data.
Withdraw consent for specific data usage.

acceptance.title: 2.1 Acceptance of Terms
acceptance.body: By accessing or using Neobyte Technology Services, you agree to these Terms of Service (the "Terms"). If you do not agree, you must discontinue use of the Services.

description.title: 2.2 Service Description
description.body: Neobyte provides software development, IT consulting, cloud deployment, system integration, and related digital solutions. Actual deliverables and timelines are defined in project contracts, proposals, statements of work (SOWs), or service-level agreements (SLAs).

obligations.title: 2.3 User Obligations
items: Refrain from unauthorized access, tampering, or misuse of systems.
Provide accurate information required for service delivery.

ip.title: 2.4 Intellectual Property
ip.body: All software, code, documentation, and materials developed by Neobyte remain our intellectual property unless otherwise stated by contract. Clients receive a limited license for business-use purposes.

payments.title: 2.5 Payments
items: Payment schedules, deposits, and milestones are outlined in service agreements.
Late payments may incur penalties or service suspension.

availability.title: 2.6 Service Availability
availability.body: Neobyte strives for consistent availability but does not guarantee uninterrupted service due to maintenance, upgrades, or external conditions.

liability.title: 2.7 Limitation of Liability
liability.body: We are not liable for indirect, consequential, incidental, or special damages. Liability is limited to the fees paid for the specific service giving rise to the claim.

termination.title: 2.8 Termination
termination.body: Either party may terminate services with written notice for material breach not resolved within the agreed timeframe.

amendments.title: 2.9 Amendments
amendments.body: Neobyte may update these Terms at any time. Continued use constitutes acceptance of the updated Terms.

law.title: 2.10 Governing Law

introduction.title: 3.1 Introduction
introduction.body: This Cookie Policy explains how Neobyte Technology uses cookies and similar tracking technologies on our websites and digital platforms.

what.title: 3.2 What Are Cookies?
what.body: Cookies are small text files stored on your device to enhance browsing experience, analyze site usage, and enable platform functionality.

types.title: 3.3 Types of Cookies We Use
items: Essential Cookies: Required for website functionality, authentication, and security.
Analytics Cookies: Measure usage, performance, and user interactions.
Preference Cookies: Store user settings and preferences.
Third-Party Cookies: Used by service providers (e.g., analytics or embedded tools).

use.title: 3.4 How We Use Cookies
items: Ensure platform functionality and secure sessions.

managing.title: 3.5 Managing Cookies
managing.body: Users may disable cookies through browser settings. However, doing so may impact functionality and access to certain features.

updates.title: 3.6 Updates
updates.body: We may update this Cookie Policy periodically. Changes take effect once posted.
